surface_name: Webhook URL behind a reverse proxy
title: n8n shows webhook URLs as http://localhost:5678 when running behind a reverse proxy
symptoms: OAuth callback or app webhook registration points to localhost
Startup warning that WEBHOOK_URL is deprecated
cause: n8n builds public URLs from its protocol, host and port settings, which describe the internal listener, not the proxy. From 2.35.0 the override is N8N_WEBHOOK_URL and the old WEBHOOK_URL logs a deprecation warning.
fix: Set the public base URL explicitly, set proxy hops to 1, and forward X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Host and X-Forwarded-Proto from the proxy.
apply:
# n8n before 2.35.0 reads WEBHOOK_URL; 2.35.0 and later read N8N_WEBHOOK_URL
WEBHOOK_URL=https://n8n.example.com/
N8N_WEBHOOK_URL=https://n8n.example.com/
N8N_PROXY_HOPS=1
affected: Self-hosted n8n behind nginx, Traefik, Caddy or a load balancer; N8N_WEBHOOK_URL naming from 2.35.0
